title: Synchrony wants your Amazon and Walmart store cards inside ChatGPT
excerpt: Synchrony is working with OpenAI to let shoppers pay inside ChatGPT with store cards, though its own executive says integration will take up to a year.
content_html:
Synchrony Financial, which issues store credit cards for Amazon, Walmart and Lowe’s, is working with OpenAI so shoppers can buy inside ChatGPT using those cards. Its chief strategy officer says general-purpose cards will take six to twelve months and store-specific cards longer.

Synchrony Financial wants its cards inside ChatGPT. The issuer behind store cards for Amazon, Walmart and Lowe’s is working with OpenAI so shoppers can complete purchases in the chat window rather than being sent to a retailer’s website.

None of it is close. Getting general-purpose cards working inside ChatGPT will take six to twelve months, according to chief strategy officer Maran Nalluswami, and private label store cards will take longer because each retailer has to be brought in separately.

The problem being solved is real enough. “What happens today is the transaction doesn’t cleanly happen yet at the provider like OpenAI,” Nalluswami said, describing a desire to ensure Synchrony’s cards are “loaded up in the right spots” when the moment comes.

This is a familiar shape by now. Two hotel groups moved into ChatGPT earlier this year and neither would let you pay there either.

OpenAI has been assembling the pieces regardless, signing deals with Stripe and putting Visa into ChatGPT for agent-initiated payments.

Synchrony is not betting on one platform. It is in talks with Anthropic and Google about embedding its cards in Claude and Gemini, in a market where Amazon has also been pushing Alexa into the same territory.

The unresolved question is who gets paid. Nobody has agreed how fees from a purchase completed inside ChatGPT should be divided between the retailer, the issuer and OpenAI, and Nalluswami says that has to be negotiated.

Demand is not obviously waiting either. Consumers remain wary of handing card details to an AI system or letting software finish a purchase on their behalf.

In Europe the obstacle is legal rather than commercial. Agentic payments still fall under PSD2 and its strong customer authentication rules, which were written on the assumption that a person authorises a specific payee, a specific amount and a specific moment.

That is awkward for a product whose entire pitch is that you do not have to be there. There is no separate regime for agentic payments in Europe and no supervisory guidance yet, which leaves the question of whether a customer authorised this purchase or merely delegated the ability to make purchases.

content_html_zh:
Synchrony Financial 为亚马逊、沃尔玛和劳氏发行商店信用卡，它正在与 OpenAI 合作，以便购物者可以使用这些卡在 ChatGPT 内购物。 其首席战略官表示，通用卡将需要六到十二个月的时间，而商店专用卡则需要更长的时间。

Synchrony Financial 希望将其卡内置于 ChatGPT 中。 亚马逊、沃尔玛和劳氏商店卡的发行人正在与 OpenAI 合作，以便购物者可以在聊天窗口中完成购买，而不是被发送到零售商的网站。

没有一个是接近的。 首席战略官 Maran Nalluswami 表示，在 ChatGPT 中使用通用卡需要六到十二个月的时间，而自有品牌商店卡则需要更长的时间，因为每个零售商都必须单独引入。

正在解决的问题是足够现实的。 Nalluswami 表示：“今天发生的情况是，像 OpenAI 这样的提供商还没有完全完成交易。”他描述了确保 Synchrony 的卡在时机到来时“加载到正确位置”的愿望。

现在这是一个熟悉的形状。 今年早些时候，两家酒店集团搬进了 ChatGPT，但都不让您在那里付款。

不管怎样，OpenAI 一直在组装这些部件，与 Stripe 签署了协议，并将 Visa 放入 ChatGPT 中以进行代理发起的支付。

同步并不是押注于一个平台。 它正在与 Anthropic 和谷歌就将其卡嵌入 Claude 和 Gemini 进行谈判，亚马逊也一直在将 Alexa 推向同一领域。

悬而未决的问题是谁得到报酬。 没有人就在 ChatGPT 内完成的购买所产生的费用如何在零售商、发行人和 OpenAI 之间分配达成一致，Nalluswami 表示这必须进行协商。

需求显然也没有等待。 消费者仍然对将银行卡详细信息交给人工智能系统或让软件代表他们完成购买持谨慎态度。

在欧洲，障碍是法律上的而不是商业上的。 代理支付仍然属于 PSD2 及其强大的客户身份验证规则的管辖范围，这些规则是基于一个人授权特定收款人、特定金额和特定时刻的假设而编写的。

对于一个产品来说，这是很尴尬的，因为它的整个宣传就是你不必在那里。 欧洲没有单独的代理支付制度，也没有监管指导，这就留下了客户是否授权这种购买或仅仅委托购买能力的问题。
